7359.title: Legacy composer preferences are ignored after compatibility retirement
7359.rootCauseOneLine: Current per-provider readers ignore global preferences after a later cleanup deliberately removed the original compatibility fallback.
7359.proposedFix: Decide whether to restore the retired legacy-upgrade compatibility; if supported, add a provider-guarded fallback preserving newer scoped and tab-local choices.
7359.caveats: Hook-level legacy-state reproduction, not an installed old-binary upgrade or a full rendered-browser test. No automatic PR: restoring deliberately retired stored-data compatibility requires a product decision.
